EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
Reference No.: DIVNA/LAD/LA/ACQUI/4/1/33.

Land Ministry’s Ref. No. : 4-3/7/2020/HW/24. I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following lands which are required for a public purpose:-

Description of the Land to be acquired : Lot No. 1 to 8 (No. of 8 Lots) allotments in total extent of about 0.0572 Hectare, of land in Cadastral Map No. 420777 Block No. 03 Sheet No. 01 and dated 29.12.2023 prepared by the Senior Superintendent of Surveyor of Kurunegala District, situated in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Narammala, situated in the Grama Niladhari Division of 1052, Palawatta, situated in the Village of Palawatta in Kurunegala District in the North West Province.
01. Lot No. 01 Name of the Land: Kuda Oya; Description: Oya; Claimant: State; Original Claimant:—; Extent : 0.0153 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid lands are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Divisional Secretariat office of Homagama on the 23rd October, 2024 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before 06th November, 2024 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
